fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 has no specified Delaunay gluing constraints or unrestricted lattice objective, and no theorem prevents overlap vertices, drops, or the constant-L1 affine lift. Its three-variable experiment misses the verified four-variable G13 collision and cannot test O6 or a growing gap.

Proposal 2 confuses tensor rank with Euclidean norm: an entangled sum of pure tensors can remain short, and rank alone supplies no distance lower bound. The G13 affine combination has norm at most nine times the honest radius for equal-radius tensor encodings, while full tensor dimension is exponential and polynomial bond compression is unspecified.

Proposal 3 gives no reason arbitrary unsatisfiability induces nontrivial holonomy. Encoding group multiplication by transition selectors and linear flow constraints preserves affine combinations of complete transcripts, recreating O6; the proposed three-variable test again omits G13 and lacks a frozen CVP instance.

Proposal 4 supplies neither a canonical secondary operation for every formula nor a theorem that unsatisfiability forces a nonzero secondary class. Any fixed-degree operation remains exposed to O4, and linear CVP gadgetization can transmit the affine lift; the proposed mod-4 computation is under-specified and cannot resolve O8.

Proposal 5 has no valid conversion from rank or a nonzero integer minor into a multiplicative CVP distance gap. Degree three is exhaustive on three variables and therefore nonrepresentative; degree Theta(log n) has n^{Theta(log n)} monomials before exterior powers, so the stated route is not polynomial, while fixed degree retains derivative kernels.

Proposal 6 does not define the transfer states, entries, target, or carry-complete lattice encoding. Determinants and spectral powers are nonlinear; linearizing them with gates or carries restores affine cancellation and potentially O1, while no theorem makes a sparse SAT defect affect a polynomial fraction of walks.

Proposal 7 only tests O2 on tiny two-clause systems. Kernel support growth does not imply a gap if honest lifted paths grow comparably, and the proposed sheet sizes and weight-eight cutoff cannot test O5, the G13 affine lift, or any dimension-dependent ratio.

Proposal 8 can reconstruct the G13 signed mixture but cannot reject it: power sums are linear in the signed measure, while positivity, Hankel rank, and atomwise legality are nonlinear constraints with no unrestricted CVP realization. Fixed K also leaves larger-support parity kernels, so the proposed collision search cannot validate O4, O6, O7, or O8.

None of the proposals emits a deterministic polynomial-size fixed-target Euclidean CVP family or an explicit n^c soundness law. Their finite tests therefore cannot discriminate the central asymptotic blocker even if they pass.
